facts.fact: Minister Samuel Nartey George says more than 1,600 of about 2,016 rural telephony sites under Ghana's project, run with GIFEC, have reportedly been completed and about 1,400 are active and carrying traffic.

GHA.note: One Million Coders centres are named only as visited; no programme count or share stated.
No budget amount, rise or spending figure stated; the 2027 budget funding is only a hope.
